stages.name: survey
stages.entry_condition: ratchet the class with task.js route.
stages.stop_condition: Done when the map has been read, the scanner has been run and quoted, its `skipped:` line has been answered rather than left as a number, and the class is said out loud.

stages.name: design
stages.stop_condition: Done when one approach, its file table, the criterion that fails now and passes after, the check against the map and the one unverified thing are all on screen.

stages.name: plan
stages.entry_condition: Read:, a fence names its file, ## Coverage.
stages.stop_condition: Done when every task carries its own test cycle, its `**Files:**` block and its `Dispatch:` line, `## Global Constraints` has been generated from the project rather than remembered, and the plan file is written.

stages.name: build
stages.entry_condition: worktree consent, brief file, reviewer template, fix rows, five rounds, commit shape.
stages.stop_condition: Done when the denominator lists nothing open, each piece has had its review as it landed, and the whole-branch review has run.

stages.name: verify
stages.entry_condition: ledger ranges, red-green, line by line.
stages.stop_condition: Done when every claim has a row with the evidence beside it, the adversary has read that table, and `docs-check` has been run.

stages.name: audit
stages.stop_condition: Done when the three scanners have been run and quoted, the adversary has read the findings, and everything not being fixed here carries a `routed:` line naming its `TODO.md` heading.

stages.name: land
stages.stop_condition: Done when the suite is green, the documents are closed, the map is rewritten and `todo-check` passes.
